notes.title: Patch 0.21
notes.content:
What's new?


Home Slot Marker
You don't have to remember where your CUBE came from during a move, we've marked the spot for you.

Tooltip permanent
The tooltip of the powerups is now permanently visible as soon as you hover over a powerup. 

Version control
To avoid version differences, we have added an update information for players whose game version is not up to date. Restart Steam and run an update to avoid errors.


Bugfixes


Skydeath
Players who had their CUBE in the air during a turn at the same time as the timer expired led to the error that the following player was skipped. This has now been fixed.

Minor bugs
We also removed minor bugs.
